sources.snippet: BioMistral 7B is the best performing open-source medical Large Language Model (LLM) in this weight category. We've publicly released the weights for BioMistral 7B on Huggingface and our full multilingual benchmark on GitHub.

sources.title: BioMistral/BioMistral - GitHub
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce BioMistral, an open-source LLM tailored for the biomedical domain, utilizing Mistral as its foundation model and further pre-trained on PubMed Central. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of BioMistral on a benchmark comprising 10 established medical question-answering (QA) tasks in English.
